$schema_note: Single source of the Semi tokens. Edit here, then `npm run build:tokens` → tokens/tokens.css. Keys are CSS custom properties without the leading --; groups only organise the file. Final names and roles: docs/TOKENS.md.

text-title-xl.note: Title of a one-column reading page (font-display, 500)

text-figure.note: Numeric figures (KPI values, totals) and the page title in a content card (400)

text-input.note: Text you type in, below sm (max-sm:text-input on fields): iOS zooms into a field under 16px

text-ui.note: Content: list and table rows, form labels and help, field values, buttons, menu items, dialog text, body (14/22). 13px compact

text-chrome.note: Shell chrome only: nav items, group labels, breadcrumb, header and toolbar compact buttons, meta (timestamps, counts, hints), kbd (12/18)

text-overline.note: Section labels only (C-032): a sidebar or drawer group, a form section, a mega menu column. Uppercase, +0.1em, 600; never a button, field label or title

text-nav-label.note: The AppShell nav group label only: 10 / 500, uppercase, normal tracking, text-faint (one class, so the size never depends on CSS order)

product.$note: Choices of a product (an app), not of its brand: one brand has a dense dashboard and a roomy store. Set on <html> (data-density, data-type-scale) and in semi-lint.json; unset = regular / even.

compact.note: Tools used all day: more on a screen (content 13px)

airy.note: Consumer, store, onboarding: one thing per screen, room around it

even.note: Titles a little larger than body text (default)

contrast.note: Marketing, store, editorial: big titles and figures

space.$note: Semantic spacing: every value is a multiple of the density unit (--semi-spacing), so data-density scales it. Utilities: p-card, gap-stack …

spacing-card.note: Padding inside a card, popover, list panel (p-card, 16px regular)

spacing-panel.note: Padding of a hero, page panel or roomy card from sm (sm:p-panel, 24px regular)

spacing-stack.note: Gap between items inside a card or form (gap-stack, 12px regular)

spacing-group.note: Gap between cards in a grid or list (gap-group, 16px regular)

shape.$note: The one Semi look (1.0: the Flat / Sharp / Soft styles are gone). Utilities read --semi-<key> (rounded-card, h-control, font-display), set on :root and every [data-theme] scope so the density unit follows a nested data-density.

radius-chip.note: Small marks: checkboxes, inline code, count marks

radius-control.note: Buttons, inputs, selects, tiles, list rows

card-border.note: Card / hero / sidebar border (border-card): transparent, cards separate by tone (bg-card); the 1px box keeps hover borders from shifting the layout

font-sans.value: var(--font-sans-family, var(--font-geist)), Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", sans-serif
font-sans.note: The UI face: everything except the few display uses (font-sans). A brand kit sets --font-sans-family

font-display.note: The brand display face: hero, reading-page title, big tabs, editorial section heads (font-display). Without fonts.display in the brand kit it is the UI sans

spacing-control.note: Toolbar controls: buttons, pills, chips, search (h-control, w-control)

font-weight-title.note: Weight of page and card titles (font-title). Headings are not bold: 400 and 500; 600 only for overlines and a few emphasised labels; 700 only in count badges

spacing.note: Tailwind spacing unit (p-4 = 4 × it). The product's density (data-density on <html>) scales every padding and gap

color-contrast.note: The contrast colour (white in dark, black in light): every line, fill and tint mixes it. No utility

color-canvas.note: Page background, the frame around the panels

color-app.note: Content column, holds the route header

color-panel.note: Nav panel, content card, sub-nav card, modal, popover

color-field-focus.note: Input fill on focus (one step darker)

color-raised.note: Segmented track, toolbar buttons, nav group dividers

color-raised-2.note: Active pill of a segmented control (on the raised track)

color-panel-0.note: Surface step 0 (C-030): the outer canvas. Same value as canvas (canvas is its alias)

color-panel-1.note: Surface step 1: halfway between canvas and app

color-panel-2.note: Surface step 2: main content. Same value as app (app is its alias)

color-panel-3.note: Surface step 3: halfway between app and panel

color-panel-4.note: Surface step 4: sidebar, modal, popover. Same value as panel (panel is its alias)

color-card.note: Content card (CARD): no border, separated by tone. Dark one step above panel (5%); light recessed below app (5%)

color-card-field.note: Field, tile or table head inside a card: one step off the card

color-tint.note: Translucent fill of a secondary button (BTN_SECONDARY): reads on every surface, no border

color-inverted.note: Neutral solid fill, the opposite of the page (near-white in dark, near-black in light): checked controls, the inverse button. Pair with on-inverted

color-text-muted.note: Descriptions, inactive tabs / nav, breadcrumb, placeholders (text-muted). 4.5:1 also on card, card-field, raised and the item fills over panel and card

color-text-faint.note: Group labels, kbd hints, "Untitled" (text-faint). Page surfaces and the card only (4.5:1 there), never on card-field, raised or an item fill

color-item-hover.note: Hover fill of rows, nav and sub-nav items (bg-item-hover)

color-item-selected.note: Selected nav / sub-nav item, selected row = the open record, selected option (bg-item-selected)

color-item-checked.note: Checked rows / cards in selection mode (bg-item-checked)

color-subtle-button.note: Fill of an ordinary content button (bg-subtle-button)

color-control-line.note: Boundary of an input you type in or tick (text field, select field, checkbox, radio): ≥ 3:1 on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Cards and tables keep line

color-divider.note: Đường phân cách nhẹ giữa các hàng

color-primary.note: Brand primary fill: the main button of a page / modal / nav, attention count badges, "New" tags, the active big-tab underline. Nothing else. A brand kit sets it

color-on-primary.note: Text / icon on bg-primary (≥ 4.5:1, picked by the brand generator)

color-secondary.note: Brand secondary fill (optional; the primary when the brand has none): the secondary main button only

color-new-tag.note: "Mới" / "New" tag fill: the brand primary at 18% (bg-new-tag, NEW_TAG / NewTag)

color-new-tag-text-dark.note: Text of the New tag in the dark theme, picked by the token build (Semi's default) or the brand generator (a kit): the brand when it reaches 4.5:1 on the tag over canvas, app, panel and card, else the strong text. Use text-on-new-tag

color-new-tag-text-light.note: Text of the New tag in the light theme (same rule as new-tag-text-dark). Use text-on-new-tag

color-on-new-tag.note: Text on bg-new-tag: the brand where it is AA on that tint, else the strong text (the token build checks it)

color-focus.note: Keyboard focus ring (ring-focus) and focused-control border: the strong text colour, ≥ 3:1 on every surface. Neutral, never the brand

color-danger-fg.note: Destructive / error text on surfaces and on its tint (≥ 4.5:1 over every surface)

color-tone-purple.note: Tonal purple text on tinted (bg-purple-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-violet.note: Tonal violet text on tinted (bg-violet-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-indigo.note: Tonal indigo text on tinted (bg-indigo-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-blue.note: Tonal blue text on tinted (bg-blue-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-sky.note: Tonal sky text on tinted (bg-sky-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-cyan.note: Tonal cyan text on tinted (bg-cyan-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-teal.note: Tonal teal text on tinted (bg-teal-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-emerald.note: Tonal emerald text on tinted (bg-emerald-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-amber.note: Tonal amber text on tinted (bg-amber-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-orange.note: Tonal orange text on tinted (bg-orange-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-rose.note: Tonal rose text on tinted (bg-rose-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-tone-pink.note: Tonal pink text on tinted (bg-pink-500/10) or neutral surfaces

color-danger-bg.note: Tinted danger surface (callout, badge, danger button)

color-danger-border.note: Border of the tinted danger surface

color-danger-solid.note: Solid danger fill (status dot, progress, destructive confirm); text on it is on-solid

color-success-bg.note: Tinted success surface (callout, badge, danger button)

color-success-border.note: Border of the tinted success surface

color-success-solid.note: Solid success fill (status dot, progress, destructive confirm); text on it is on-solid

color-warning-bg.note: Tinted warning surface (callout, badge, danger button)

color-warning-border.note: Border of the tinted warning surface

color-warning-solid.note: Solid warning fill (status dot, progress, destructive confirm); text on it is on-solid

color-info-bg.note: Tinted info surface (callout, badge, danger button)

color-info-border.note: Border of the tinted info surface

color-info-solid.note: Solid info fill (status dot, progress, destructive confirm); text on it is on-solid

color-overlay.note: Backdrop behind modals, sheets and dialogs

shadow-overlay.note: Floating layers only: modal, popover, menu, toast

shadow-tint.note: Colour of a tinted shadow; no utility

color-chart-1.note: Chart series 1 (blue); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-2.note: Chart series 2 (orange); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-3.note: Chart series 3 (aqua); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-4.note: Chart series 4 (yellow); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-5.note: Chart series 5 (magenta); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-6.note: Chart series 6 (plum); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-7.note: Chart series 7 (violet); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

color-chart-8.note: Chart series 8 (red); fixed order, never cycled. Marks only, never text

motion.$note: Motion tokens (docs/TOKENS.md). Each is a duration + easing usable in a transition or animation shorthand: transition: background-color var(--motion-hover). Under prefers-reduced-motion the distances and scale go to zero, so every entrance is opacity only. T9 wires the components.

motion-hover.note: Colour changes on hover / active (buttons, links, rows)

motion-enter.note: Page content entering once per route: opacity + translateY(var(--motion-enter-distance) → 0) (animate-enter)

motion-stagger.note: Delay between staggered items (first ~10 only, once per route)

motion-slide.note: Sliding active pill of a segmented control / pill tabs

motion-crumb-distance.note: Breadcrumb entrance offset (0 under reduced motion)

motion-enter-distance.note: Content entrance offset (0 under reduced motion)

motion-tooltip-scale.note: Tooltip entrance scale (1 under reduced motion)

transition-hover: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity

z-sheet.note: A sheet opened from a dialog (number pad, picker): above dialogs, below popovers
